sentences.en: The king ordered that the prisoner should be set free.
sentences.zh: 国王命令释放那位囚犯。

sentences.en: Were I free from work, I could read these books.
sentences.zh: 要是我不忙的话，就可以读这些书了。

sentences.en: The old man freed the little fox from the trap.
sentences.zh: 老人把小狐狸从陷阱里救了出来。
